answer: Every oasis must register on the anchor, a single global registry whose entry price ignores wallets: the n-th oasis admitted in an epoch locks n glacier for 100 epochs, slashed if it is later judged fake. Splitting across fresh wallets or hosts changes nothing, because all entrants collide on one counter. An honest newcomer in a quiet epoch locks about 5 glacier; 1,000 clones in one epoch lock about 500,500, and trickling them in at 10 per epoch means 100 epochs exposed to slashing. It breaks if a patient attacker evades judges, or floods price out honest entrants.
